acceptanceCriteria.text: Misaligned edge hover shows a one-shot proximity beacon, then stops
Trigger align Top/Center/Bottom visually matches the hover strip
Beacon does not steal clicks (click-through still holds when collapsed)

checkpointPayload.description: When the cursor hits the stuck edge outside the trigger Y strip, flash a 1.5px hairline beacon once. CSS clipPath of the hub must match Top/Center/Bottom trigger geometry from main.
checkpointPayload.implementationNotes: Edge-Drop README: Edge Location Hint. Renderer draws; main still owns triggerRect.
checkpointPayload.title: [smooth-03] Proximity beacon + trigger clipPath

taskChanges.newValue:
1. Extend EdgeCursorEvent with edgeHit (or miss) so strip-miss is once-per-approach, not 60Hz.
2. Renderer hairline 1.5px pointer-events none; skip pulse if reduceMotion.
3. CSS clipPath of collapsed hub matches shelf.heightRatio + triggerAlign used by PanelHost.triggerRect.
4. Must not open panel and must not steal clicks while click-through.
5. Manual: trigger Center, hover top of edge = beacon only.
D2=pass D5=pass.
